Adding the billing-path diagram as discussed. High-level options summarized in the image and short notes below.

Attachment: billing-path-diagram.png (diagram)

Notes:
- Option A (AWS-billed): AWS issues monthly invoice to Aurelia; Aurelia pays AWS. Less coordination, recommended when finance wants AWS invoices.
- Option B (Redwood-billed): Redwood invoices Aurelia monthly (Net 30); Redwood passes through AWS charges. Useful if Aurelia prefers single vendor relationship; requires Redwood to be the billing entity on the private offer.
- Taxes: Redwood can provide tax registration details if Option B is selected.
